verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents an API for embedded accounting that was 'originally architected for deep platform-to-platform integrations', plus an MCP integration with Claude. These suggest programmatic, non-UI access is possible, but nothing shows it running headlessly or in CI pipelines, and the platform-to-platform framing hints that access may be partner-oriented. Missing for 10: CLI or headless runner, CI/automation docs, a public OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), API auth/token docs for self-serve automation, and hands-on corroboration.
